corrected_claim: On December 18 2024 the FOMC cut rates by 25bp as expected, but Chair Powell's guidance (2025 dot plot reduced to two cuts) triggered a sharp selloff: Dow fell ~1,100-1,123 points, S&P 500 fell 2.95% (just under 3%, not nearly 4%), Nasdaq fell about 3.56% (~700 points, not 1,000), with selling throughout the session.

corrected_claim: On November 26 2021 the first Omicron cases triggered a Dow decline of 905 points (~2.5%, worst single-session drop of 2021), closing 'down more than 900 points'; the preceding day (Nov 24) the Dow fell ~260 points as reports of the new variant emerged.

notes: Date (Nov 26 2021), ~1,000-pt Dow sink and Omicron-trigger verified; precise close was -905 pts / -2.53%, so 'about 1000 points' is within c.10% rounding - marked corrected for accuracy.

corrected_claim: On February 3 2026 the India-US trade deal (announced Feb 2-3 2026) sparked a record rally: GIFT Nifty indicated a gap-up of roughly 700 points per News18, the Sensex jumped about 3,600 points at the open (largest single-session open rally in its history), Nifty jumped ~4.8% intraday and logged its best day since May 2025, closing about 2.5-4.8% higher.

evidence.title: Dalal Street roars as India-US deal sparks record rally, Nifty jumps 4.8%, Sensex surges over 3,600 points - ANI News
Nifty Set For Rally Today As India-US Trade Deal Sparks 700-Point Surge In GIFT Nifty - News18
Stock Market Today February 03: Markets rally big after India-US Trade deal, Sensex jumps 3,600 points at open - Punjab Kesari English
India's Nifty 50 closes 2.5% higher as long-awaited U.S. trade deal boosts investor sentiment - CNBC

notes: Event and date (Feb 3, 2026) verified; Nifty +4.8% intraday / +2.5-4.8% close. The '~2000-point GIFT Nifty gap-up' is overstated: reported GIFT Nifty indication was ~700 points (pre-open), with the intraday rally then expanding. GIFT Nifty futures do not trade at a 2,000-pt premium; Nifty gained ~1,250-1,300 pts intraday at ~26,000 levels.

notes: 2013 Fed taper signal triggered global EM selloff; India was among hardest hit (rupee to record lows, heavy FII selling, May-Aug 2013). Nifty fell ~17-20% from May-2013 peak (~6,248) to Aug-2013 low (~5,118); 'roughly 20%' is within accepted reporting range.

notes: May-2022 CPI printed 8.6% (40-year high) on Jun 10 2022; S&P -2.9% Jun 10 and -3.9% Jun 13 (bear market); Dow -880 (Jun 10) and -900 (Jun 13); Nasdaq fell ~13% cumulatively Jun 8-Jun 16 2022 (~10% in the first 2-3 sessions after the print).
